headline: STATE GIVES UP TO 5,000 EUROS FOR VEHICLE PURCHASE: Deadline for Electric Vehicle Subsidies Extended
summary: The Serbian government extended the deadline for applications for subsidies to buy new electric vehicles from 30 September to 1 December 2026. Subsidies of up to 5,000 euros are available to citizens, entrepreneurs and companies.
why: Vehicle purchase subsidies influence electric car sales volumes and the demand outlook for EV makers and charging networks.
